svg.text: Indexes every branch; queues a build only where new commits landed

g.text: Queued builds run one after another

svg.text: + 8 more service branches, each with its own Jenkinsfile
Only branches with new commits are queued — every other service's job stays untouched
Developer -> GitHub branch -> Jenkins Multibranch scan (build only what changed) -> Docker Hub -> kubectl apply -> EKS (webapps namespace)
